title: Chapter 409 Two Platinum-Level Bosses
content:
Chapter 409 Two Platinum-Level Bosses

Guliji immediately climbed up a big tree and looked intently. She saw a great battle taking place on another hill in the distance.

But it was too far to see clearly.

Wang Shuo looked at Zhu Dongheng and said, "Let's go and have a look?"

"Let's go. Maybe we can find a loophole!"

So, everyone walked on the snow and ran quickly to another hill.

The snow on the mountain was very deep, and even some mountain streams and gullies were filled with snow.

Releasing the mount was not as fast as everyone using internal force and walking on the snow.

After running quickly for half an hour, Wang Shuo saw the two sides of the battle in the distance.

A snow monster fought a snow leopard. Both giant beasts were diamond-level bosses, and belonged to the same level as human intermediate warriors.

Wang Shuo had to be serious and observe the momentum of the two bosses. Wang Shuo was really not sure that he could defeat it.

Everyone had to hide in the distance and watch the battle quietly.

The snow leopard jumped high and bit the snow monster's arm.

The snow monster looks similar to the snow ape, but the snow monster does not have such thick fur, but more solid muscles.

At the same time, his body is larger, which may be because it is a diamond-level boss.

The snow leopard, which flew over, was extremely powerful and bit his arm, but it did not bite it off, but only bit a deep tooth mark.

The blood flowing from the arm was not bright red, but milky white, which looked a bit like tree sap.

The snow monster bared his teeth and kept roaring in his mouth. At the same time, he grabbed one of the snow leopard's thighs with his other hand and tore it hard.

But the snow leopard bit it tightly and refused to let go.

The snow monster endured the severe pain and directly pulled off the snow leopard and a large piece of flesh on his arm with a force.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank, and it hurt to watch.

The snow leopard was thrown far away, leaving a deep gully on the snow.

The battle between the two bosses was extremely fierce.

Just as Wang Shuo was watching in a trance, two more people ran over.

One of them had a thin face, wearing a thick fur coat, a fur hat, and a big knife on his back. The big knife exuded a chill that was even colder than the weather.

The other one was even more exaggerated, with muscular torsos, bare arms, and half of his body exposed in the ice and snow. He moved quickly and didn't look frozen at all.

Looking at the two people, they looked relaxed, and it was obvious that they were not easy to deal with.

It was just that the two of them didn't get close to each other, which was a safe distance. The two people should not be in the same group, which was good news for Wang Shuo.

It was obvious that everyone was interested in these two bosses.

Wang Shuo even suspected that these two bosses were also interested in the people who came.

Otherwise, they should stop when they saw someone approaching.

In this way, everyone watched the fight between the two bosses quietly, and they all tacitly did not make any other moves.

The snow monster had several wounds on his body, but the snow leopard was also in pain.

Its right hind leg was already lame. Wang Shuo guessed that several ribs were broken and even its internal organs were injured.

Because the punch the snow monster threw at the snow leopard just now had a faint blue light on its fist, which clearly showed that it had used some skill. The part of the snow leopard that was hit was obviously dented.

Soon, the battle came to an end.

The wounded snow monster won the victory.

It roared a few times to warn everyone.

Then it smashed the snow leopard's head with a punch, trying to devour the opponent's magic core.

At this time, the other two moved and pounced on the snow monster together.

Wang Shuo was also a little anxious at this time, looking at Zhu Dongheng who was ready to move.
